title.narrative: Judicial Performance Enhancement for Service to Citizen Project ('Mahkamati')

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to strengthen the capacity of the Borrower's justice sector to deliver efficient, timely and transparent services to citizens and businesses through: (a) piloting of a participatory reform process involving judges, administrative staff, judicial auxiliaries and users in selected courts in the Project Area; and (b) strengthening the institutional capacity of the central functions of the MdJL to better support and monitor the court system.

The development objective of the Judicial Performance Enhancement for Service to Citizen Project is to strengthen the capacity of the Borrower's justice sector to deliver efficient, timely and transparent services to citizens and businesses through: piloting of a participatory reform process involving judges, administrative staff, judicial auxiliaries and users in selected courts in the project area; and strengthening the institutional capacity of the central functions of the Ministry of Justice and Liberties (MdJL) to better support and monitor the court system. There are three components to the project. The first component of the project is improving court performance in the project area. The objective of this component is to have a direct impact on the quality and efficiency of service delivery by the courts. The second component of the project is upgrading the strategic planning and management capacities of the MdJL. The objective of this component is to improve the MdJL's capacity to monitor the performance of the courts and provide them with adequate support, in particular to attain the strategic objectives of component one. The third component of the project is project management, monitoring and evaluation. The objective of this component is to support the MdJL's capacity to manage, monitor and evaluate project activities.
